Susan T. Mullen was born in Cambridge, Massachusetts, on 24 August 1857, the daughter of James Mullen, a coffin maker, and his wife Catherine (McElaney).<ref name="susanbirth">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FXCL-6C3 : accessed 18 November 2026), Susan T. Parents James and Catherine Mullen; father a coffin maker, born Charlestown; mother born Cambridge.</ref> She married James W. O'Donnell in Boston on 21 September 1882.<ref name="marr1882">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NW5J-1BC : accessed 18 November 2026), James W. O'Donnell and Susan T. Mullen, married 21 Sep 1882, Boston, entry 2849. Bride 21, born Cambridge, parents James and Catharine.</ref>
